# Panel

PanelContainer: the panel's own surface, at a fixed or the provider's width.

A full-height layer with no Blanket. Details sits on the right, docked beside the Page when it fits and floating over it when it does not; Notifications, the Inbox, sits at the start beside the Sidebar. Two types: Details and Notifications. The AI panel is a region of the Frame.

Import the Panel and its parts from `@/templates`. This template documents the parts and its layout within the Frame.

Also asked as: right panel, detail panel, side pane, slide-over, sheet, side sheet, off-canvas, right sidebar, side panel, inspector.

## Usage

Use a Panel when content is read beside the page and outlives a click: a quick look at a row, a short edit with the table in view, the Inbox. It never has a Blanket, so the page behind stays usable. Details sits on the right, docked beside the Page from 1168 and floating over it under that. The Inbox opens from the Sidebar's bell, beside the Sidebar at the start, 360 wide, over the page. One floating Panel is open at a time; opening another replaces it.

The AI panel is not a floating Panel. It is a region of the Frame, docked where there is room, so it persists across pages.

## Motion

Panel reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| docked-enter | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-slow` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The AI Panel slides in from its edge while the page makes room; its content fades in once the page is about 90% done. A docked Panel never has a Blanket. |
| docked-exit | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | Reverses and stays at the edge. |
| floating-enter | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | Details slides in from its edge over the page. A quick look promoted to its record grows from the Panel itself. |
| floating-exit | Dock and undock a panel | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | Reverses. |
| start-enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The Inbox, opened from the Sidebar bell, fades in beside the Sidebar with no travel, like a menu. From the keyboard it opens with no animation. In-app Reduced mode shows it with no animation; the system reduced-motion setting keeps the fade. |
| start-exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades in place, the same as the enter. |
| narrow-enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-slow` | At narrow widths it slides over with a Blanket. |
| narrow-exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | The same way back. |

## Alternatives

- For a decision that must happen before the page continues, use `Modal`.
- For a queue page, use `Panel` docked beside the list; the record opens on demand.
- For a short aside off a control, use `Popup`.
- For complex or multistep work, give the record its own page with a multi-step task on `Frame`.

## Best practices

### Float a Panel with no Blanket. {#float-a-panel-with-no-blanket}

**Checked:** Automatic

The page keeps scrolling and stays clickable. A press on the page outside the Panel, or Escape, closes it. Narrow, it is capped and then full width, still with no Blanket. A confirm Modal over a Panel brings its own Blanket.

Do: The Panel floats on its shadow and the page beside it stays undimmed.
Don't: The same details in a Modal: a Blanket dims the whole page.

### Open one floating Panel at a time. {#open-one-floating-panel-at-a-time}

**Checked:** Automatic

Another row swaps the content; opening the Inbox replaces Details, and opening Details replaces the Inbox. The overlay module keeps a second overlay closed.

Do: One Panel; another row swaps what it shows.
Don't: Two Panels open at once, the second covering the first.

### Keep the picked row highlighted while Details is open. {#keep-the-picked-row-highlighted-while-details-is-open}

**Checked:** Review

Picking the same row again closes it; Up and Down step through the rows.

### Show a footer only while editing. {#show-a-footer-only-while-editing}

**Checked:** Review

Discard (Default) and Save (Primary), full bleed; Close in the header dismisses, so no Cancel. A declining action such as "Keep editing" is Default, in the left half. Reading needs no footer.

Do: Reading: a header and a body, nothing to save.
Don't: A footer of buttons on a Panel that is only read.

### Leave the AI panel uncovered. {#leave-the-ai-panel-uncovered}

**Checked:** Review

A floating Panel and the docked AI panel sit side by side. The AI panel is never covered. This pair is Planned.

The docked AI panel here is a second Panel in the docked slot; its own placement beside a floating Panel is not built yet.

Do: The floating Panel beside the docked AI panel, both fully visible.
Don't: The floating Panel drawn over the AI panel, hiding part of it.

### Move a Panel that needs full attention into a Modal. {#move-a-panel-that-needs-full-attention-into-a-modal}

**Checked:** Review

If the person must not look at anything outside it, it is a Modal.

### Open the Inbox beside the Sidebar. {#open-the-inbox-beside-the-sidebar}

**Checked:** Review

Its left edge sits against the Sidebar, over the left of the Page. Picking an item opens its page behind the Inbox, which stays open. Flags still show at the top right.

### Give the Panel room to read. {#give-the-panel-room-to-read}

**Checked:** Review

Below its default width the title wraps and the body stops being scannable.

Do: Default width.
Don't: Squeezed to a narrow strip.

### Keep the header to one cue. {#keep-the-header-to-one-cue}

**Checked:** Review

An icon, a back action and a subheader together bury the title; pick the one the task needs.

### Share one width across a page's Panels with `PanelProvider`. {#share-one-width-across-a-page-s-panels-with-panelprovider}

**Checked:** Review

Wrap the region that can open Panels in a `PanelProvider`, and read or change the shared width with `usePanelManager`, so Panels opened over time stay the same size instead of each picking its own.

```jsx
<PanelProvider>
    <PanelContainer>
        <PanelHeader title="Student detail" actions={<PanelCloseAction onClick={close} />} />
        <PanelBody>...</PanelBody>
    </PanelContainer>
</PanelProvider>
```

### Reach for the fixed action components before building your own. {#reach-for-the-fixed-action-components-before-building-your-own}

**Checked:** Review

`PanelBackAction`, `PanelCloseAction` and the rest already carry the right icon, label and compact spacing; a custom `IconButton` for the same job risks a different icon or label than the rest of the system uses.

### Title the Panel with the object. {#title-the-panel-with-the-object}

**Checked:** Review

"Session · Mar 4", not "Details", so someone who opened it from elsewhere still knows.

### Offer "Open as page" in More. {#offer-open-as-page-in-more}

**Checked:** Review

For the step up when the quick look is not enough.

## Accessibility

- Floating, the Panel is a complementary landmark named by its title, after the Page in reading order. Focus moves to its title on open and returns to the row, or to the bell for the start-side Inbox, on close.
- Floating at a narrow width it is a dialog: focus is trapped, and Escape, a press outside or Close return it.
- The Frame closes the Panel on Escape unless an inner control handles it, such as an open menu.
- Up and Down are named "Previous" and "Next" and announce the record that opens.
- **`usePanelManager` outside a provider fails loudly.** Calling it without a `PanelProvider` ancestor throws, rather than silently falling back, so a missing provider is caught during development.
- An unread dot is paired with the text "unread" for a screen reader.

## Types

Neither has a Blanket. Details opens on the right, docked beside the Page when it fits and floating over it when it does not (Width behavior has the widths); floating at every width is Planned. Notifications opens at the start, beside the Sidebar.

- **Details.** A quick look at a row, docked beside the Page or floating over its right by width. The picked row stays highlighted.
- **Notifications.** The Inbox, opened from the bell beside your name. It opens beside the Sidebar, 360 wide, and stays open as you pick one.

## Anatomy

### Details

Opened from a session row. The page behind stays usable.

1. **Splitter.** On the Page-facing edge; it resizes from 320 to 640.
2. **Header.** The title names the record, with its status in the Subheader row under it; then Edit and the fixed actions: Up, Down, More, Close.
3. **Body.** The record's Sections. It scrolls between the header and the footer.

The picked row stays highlighted on the page while the Panel is open.

### Notifications

Picking an item opens its page behind the Panel and marks it read. The Inbox stays open.

1. **Header.** The title, Mark all as read and Close.
2. **Tabs.** Unread, with its count, and All.
3. **Items.** One `NotificationItem` per update, grouped by day. An unread item says "Unread" to a screen reader.

The bell at the end of the Sidebar's account row, with its unread count, opens the Inbox. The Inbox opens beside the Sidebar at `--inbox-width` (360) over the page, never covers the Sidebar, and closes on Escape, with focus back on the bell, on an outside click or on Close.

## Width behavior

Drag the Frame's width. From 1168 a 400 Panel docks beside the Page at an edge line with no shadow. Under it the Panel floats on the overlay material and shadow, capped at 320 under 1024 and full width under 768. It never has a Blanket.

## Composition

The parts on their own, outside a Frame, at the width they are given.

## Key states

- **Editing.** The same Panel with the form open and its full-bleed footer: Discard (Default) left and Save (Primary) right; Close in the header dismisses, so no Cancel. Save returns to reading, which has no footer.

- **With a form.** A short edit of a row with the page still in view: the fields in the body and the Panel's own footer. Validation and leaving with edits: Forms.

- **Record gone.** When the row no longer exists the body shows its empty state with a way back: Empty.

- **Under 1024.** Too narrow to dock beside the table: the Panel floats on the overlay material and shadow, capped as Width behavior says, still with no Blanket.

### Beside the AI panel

A floating Panel and the docked AI panel sit side by side, and the AI panel is never covered. The Frame has one Panel area today, so this pair is Planned.

## Parts

1. **Container** (`PanelContainer`). The outer surface. Its `width` falls back to the nearest `PanelProvider`'s width, then to `--panel-width-default`; inside the Frame's Panel area it fills the area instead.
2. **Header** (`PanelHeader`). An optional back action, an optional title icon, the title, and an action group (`PanelCloseAction`, `PanelMoreAction`).
3. **Subheader** (`PanelSubheader`). An optional row of secondary content under the header: tabs, a filter summary.
4. **Body** (`PanelBody`). The main content, which scrolls.
5. **Footer** (`PanelFooter`). Actions that commit a change, with an optional `PanelDisclaimer` for small print beside them.
6. **Overlay** (`PanelOverlay`). A Panel that floats over the Page with no Blanket, opened from a trigger. `placement="start"` opens it on the Sidebar's end edge at `--inbox-width`; `"end"` opens at the far edge. Escape and a press outside close it, a press on the trigger is its own toggle, and focus returns to the trigger. It fades on `appearance.fast`, like a menu.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The page ground with a leading edge. |
| Hovered | Nothing changes on the panel. |
| Pressed | Nothing changes on the panel. |
| Focused | Not focusable. Focus goes to the fixed actions and the content. |
| Disabled | A panel has no disabled state. Disable the controls in it. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Ground and edge | `--ds-surface`; `--ds-border` at `--border-width-default` on the leading edge. |
| Header | Padding `--panel-pad-y` and `--panel-pad`; `--panel-inline-md` between its parts; `--border-width-default` rule below. |
| Action group | `--panel-inline-sm` between actions. |
| Subheader | Padding `--panel-subheader-pad-y` and `--panel-pad`; `--border-width-default` rule below. |
| Body | Padding `--panel-pad`. |
| Footer | Padding `--panel-pad-y` and `--panel-pad`, `--panel-inline-lg` between its parts; rule above; disclaimer in `--body-sm`, `--ds-text-subtle`. |

## Slots

```jsx
import { Frame, PanelContainer, PanelHeader, PanelBody, PanelFooter, PanelOverlay } from '@/templates';
```

The Panel components are the parts: header with its fixed actions, subheader, body, footer and disclaimer. The Frame hosts one, decides whether it docks or floats, and closes it on Escape. The template is its filled layout, one per type. The AI panel is the Frame's `panel`.

| Slot | Details | Notifications |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | The record's name, with its StatusTag under it | "Inbox" |
| `actions` | Edit, then Up, Down, More and Close | Mark all as read and Close |
| `backAction` · `titleIcon` | Optional, in the header before the title: a back action (`PanelBackAction`) and an icon. Pick the one the task needs. | None |
| `subheader` (`PanelSubheader`) | The record's StatusTag under the title | None: the Unread and All tabs sit under the header |
| `body` | Sections of the record; the form while editing | Items grouped by day, in Unread and All tabs |
| `footer` · `disclaimer` (`PanelFooter`, `PanelDisclaimer`) | Only while editing: Discard and Save, full bleed; Close in the header dismisses, so no Cancel. The page composes it from Button. Planned as a prop. A `PanelDisclaimer` carries small print beside the actions. | None |
| Placement | Right. Docked from 1168; floating under it. Floating at every width is Planned. | Start, beside the Sidebar, 360 wide (`--inbox-width`), over the page with no Blanket. `PanelOverlay` with `placement="start"`, opened from the Sidebar's bell rather than the Frame's Panel area. |
| Beside the AI panel | Planned. The Frame has one Panel area. | Planned. |

## Sizes

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--panel-width-default` | 400 | The width a Panel opens at. |
| `--inbox-width` | 360 | The width the Inbox opens at, beside the Sidebar. |
| `--panel-min-width` | 320 | The narrowest, and the cap under 1024. |
| `--ds-surface-material-overlay`, `--ds-border-material`, `--ds-shadow-overlay` | pair | The floating Panel's fill, edge and elevation. The fill is translucent with no blur, and turns solid under reduced transparency and increased contrast. A docked or standalone Panel uses `--ds-surface` and an edge line. |
| `--ds-border` | 1 | The edge line where a docked Panel meets the Page. |

The Panel resizes from 320 to 640 by drag or keys, never past what keeps 720 of content beside it.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Title Details with the record: "Ana Ruiz · Thu 4:00 PM". | "Details". |
| Name the filter by what it keeps: "Unread". | "Filter". |
| Give the empty state a way back: "Back to sessions". | "Nothing here". |
| Keep the disclaimer to one line. | Put instructions in the footer that belong in the body. |
| Name the footer's actions: "Discard" and "Save". | "OK" and "Done". |
